hooks.command: cd $CWD && if git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -q 'supabase/functions'; then echo 'Edge Function changed — flag for MCP deploy_edge_function, never dashboard paste.'; fi

hooks.prompt: Check: did the tester subagent report a verdict for every change made this session, labeled either 'PASSED — TESTED FOR REAL' or 'PASSED BASIC CHECK ONLY — NOT TESTED IN A BROWSER'? If the tester hasn't weighed in at all, return {"decision": "block", "reason": "tester has not checked this yet — hand off to tester before finishing"}. Otherwise return {"decision": "allow"} — either label is fine to finish on, as long as one was given honestly.
